description:
PoX-5 sBTC rewards an address has earned from its signer manager for one reward cycle and not yet claimed (before the manager's fees), whether the manager still has to pull them from pox-5, and whether the manager supports an on-chain staker claim.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

address.description: Stacks address. Uses the active wallet if omitted.

signerManager.description: Signer manager to check. Defaults to the address's current signer manager.

name: get_stacking_rewards
